objects.description: [ShinyHunters](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1057) has used valid cloud accounts to gain initial access or to escalate privileges within cloud environments.(Citation: SOCRadar_ShinyHunters_Mar2024) Additionally, [ShinyHunters](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1057) has also used valid credentials from public repositories to include access keys to gain access to the victim organization’s AWS environment.(Citation: Unit42KelleyVaya_BlingLibra_Aug2024)(Citation: Intel471_SH_Aug2021)
